notes.title: Updated version with RTX
notes.content:
[h1]Graphics.[/h1]

[h2]RTX support.[/h2]
If you own NVidia RTX series graphics cards, you can enjoy ray tracing. It's turned on automatically if you have an RTX series graphics card. If you don't have an RTX series graphics card, you can still play the game, but without ray tracing.
[h2]Updated Graphics.[/h2]
The game has updated all the graphics, now the image looks more attractive. And with raytracing the best is even better!

[b]New version:[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40010543/b1bdd00cfd2f4d743d59193a7b346b677c8326f6.jpg[/img]
[b]Old version:[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40010543/8de27200a09b567226ef6d991e32b3fc6270003c.png[/img]

[h1]Changes in the game.[/h1]

[h2]Lightened AI.[/h2]
Enemies are even easier than in the previous version. You are now given more chances to react than before. If you have already played and it seemed too difficult for you, it should be much easier now.
[h2]Small changes.[/h2]
Added a few updates in some places, you can find them yourself playing the game.
